name: focusspace
description: FocusSpace — an intent-driven learning layer for YouTube (Chrome extension, Manifest V3).

scripts.dev: npm run icons && (vite build --mode development --watch & vite build --config vite.content.config.ts --mode development --watch & vite build --config vite.content.config.ts --mode bridge --watch)
scripts.build: npm run icons && npm run typecheck && npm run build:fast
scripts.build:fast: vite build && vite build --config vite.content.config.ts && vite build --config vite.content.config.ts --mode bridge && vite build --config vite.content.config.ts --mode site
